_comment: Digital Confidence Centre — Module Quiz Questions. 5 per module, modules 1–19. ans is 0-based index of correct option.

1.q: What is the most reliable way to exit an app on any device?
opts: Pull out the battery
Press the Home button or swipe up
Turn off the Wi-Fi
Wait for it to close itself
1.explain: The Home button (or swipe-up on newer devices) is your Escape Hatch — it instantly leaves any app or website without causing any damage. It works every time.
1.explain_fr: Le bouton principal (ou glissement vers le haut) est votre Trappe de Sortie — il quitte immédiatement toute application ou site Web sans causer de dommages.

1.q: You see a scary message saying your device has a virus. What should you do first?
opts: Call the number on the screen
Press the Home button to leave the page
Type in your password to fix it
Turn off your phone immediately
1.explain: Fake virus warnings are one of the most common scams. Press Home to leave — do not call the number, do not enter any passwords. Your device is fine.
1.explain_fr: Les faux avertissements de virus sont parmi les arnaques les plus courantes. Appuyez sur Accueil pour partir — n'appelez pas le numéro.

1.q: What does it mean when an app is "frozen" (not responding)?
opts: The device temperature is too cold
The app has stopped working temporarily
You need to buy a new device
Your internet is broken
1.explain: A frozen app has simply stopped responding. Force-closing it (swipe up from Home screen) and reopening it almost always fixes the problem.
1.explain_fr: Une application figée a simplement cessé de répondre. La fermer de force et la rouvrir résout presque toujours le problème.

1.q: How do you close an app completely on an iPad?
opts: Delete the app icon
Double-tap Home (or swipe up from the bottom) and swipe the app away
Shake the iPad
Turn off Wi-Fi
1.explain: Double-tapping Home (or swiping up and pausing) opens the App Switcher. Swipe the app card upward to force-close it.
1.explain_fr: Appuyer deux fois sur Accueil ouvre le Sélecteur d'app. Balayez la carte de l'application vers le haut pour la fermer.

1.q: If you tap something by mistake and a page opens that worries you, what is the fastest solution?
opts: Call 911
Tap the back arrow or press Home to leave the page
Smash the screen
Wait for 10 minutes
1.explain: The back arrow or Home button instantly takes you away from any worrying page. Nothing bad happens from accidentally opening a website.
1.explain_fr: La flèche de retour ou le bouton Accueil vous éloigne immédiatement de toute page inquiétante. Rien de grave ne se passe si vous ouvrez accidentellement un site.

2.q: A caller says they are from "Microsoft Support" and needs your password to fix a problem. What do you do?
opts: Give them your password — Microsoft needs it
Hang up. Real companies never ask for passwords by phone.
Ask them to call back tomorrow
Give them your email address instead
2.explain: No legitimate company — Microsoft, Apple, your bank, or any government agency — will ever call you and ask for a password. Hang up immediately.
2.explain_fr: Aucune entreprise légitime ne vous appellera jamais pour demander un mot de passe. Raccrochez immédiatement.

opts: A type of internet fishing game
A scam that tries to trick you into giving personal information
A way to make your phone faster
A Canadian government programme
2.explain: Phishing is when scammers send fake emails or texts pretending to be trusted organisations to steal your passwords, banking details, or other personal information.
2.explain_fr: L'hameçonnage, c'est quand des escrocs envoient de faux courriels ou textos en se faisant passer pour des organisations de confiance afin de voler vos informations.

2.q: You receive an email saying you have won $500. What is the most likely truth?
opts: You really won — claim it immediately
It is almost certainly a scam — delete it
Forward it to all your friends
Reply to find out more details
2.explain: Unexpected prize emails are almost always scams. If you did not enter a contest, you cannot have won one. Delete it without replying.
2.explain_fr: Les courriels de prix inattendus sont presque toujours des arnaques. Si vous n'avez pas participé à un concours, vous ne pouvez pas en avoir gagné un.

2.q: Which of these is a sign of a fake website?
opts: It has a padlock icon
It asks for your banking password in an email link
It loads quickly
It has a phone number listed
2.explain: Legitimate websites — including your bank — will never send you a link asking you to enter your banking password. When in doubt, go directly to the website yourself.
2.explain_fr: Les sites légitimes, y compris votre banque, ne vous enverront jamais un lien vous demandant votre mot de passe bancaire. En cas de doute, allez directement sur le site vous-même.

2.q: How long should you wait before reporting a scam attempt to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre?
opts: 30 days
1 year
Report it as soon as possible
Only if you lost money
2.explain: Report scam attempts to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre (1-888-495-8501) as soon as possible — even if you did not lose money. Your report helps protect others.
2.explain_fr: Signalez les tentatives d'arnaque au Centre antifraude du Canada (1-888-495-8501) dès que possible, même si vous n'avez pas perdu d'argent.

opts: Using your pet's name
A mix of upper and lower case letters, numbers, and symbols — at least 12 characters
Using your birthday
A single common word
3.explain: A strong password is long (12+ characters), unique, and uses a mix of character types. Avoid anything personally connected to you like names or birthdays.
3.explain_fr: Un mot de passe fort est long (12+ caractères), unique et utilise un mélange de types de caractères. Évitez tout ce qui est personnellement lié à vous.

opts: A second password you create
A security step where a code is sent to your phone to confirm it's really you
Two people sharing one account
A type of antivirus software
3.explain: Two-factor authentication adds a second check — usually a code sent by text to your phone. Even if someone steals your password, they still cannot get in.
3.explain_fr: L'authentification à deux facteurs ajoute une deuxième vérification — généralement un code envoyé par texto. Même si quelqu'un vole votre mot de passe, il ne peut toujours pas entrer.

3.q: Face ID or a fingerprint is safer than a PIN because:
opts: It is quicker
No one else has your face or fingerprint
You can share it with family
It never needs updating
3.explain: Biometrics (your face or fingerprint) are unique to you. Nobody can guess or steal them the way they can steal a PIN or password.
3.explain_fr: La biométrie (votre visage ou empreinte digitale) vous est unique. Personne ne peut les deviner ou les voler comme ils le feraient avec un NIP ou un mot de passe.

3.q: You have the same password for your email and your bank. This is:
opts: A good idea — easier to remember
Risky — if one is stolen, both are at risk
Required by the bank
Recommended by Apple
3.explain: Password reuse is one of the biggest security risks. If a scammer gets one password, they will immediately try it on your bank, email, and other accounts.
3.explain_fr: La réutilisation des mots de passe est l'un des plus grands risques de sécurité. Si un escroc obtient un mot de passe, il l'essaiera immédiatement sur votre banque et courriel.

opts: Resets your password every day
Stores your passwords securely so you only need one master password
Shares passwords with your family
Sends passwords to Apple for safekeeping
3.explain: A password manager (like Apple's built-in Passwords app) stores all your passwords in an encrypted vault. You only remember one master password.
3.explain_fr: Un gestionnaire de mots de passe stocke tous vos mots de passe dans un coffre-fort chiffré. Vous ne devez retenir qu'un seul mot de passe principal.

4.q: Where is the safest place to download apps on an iPhone or iPad?
opts: Any website on the internet
Only from the Apple App Store
From email links
From your friend's device via Bluetooth
4.explain: The Apple App Store reviews every app before listing it. Downloading apps from any other source bypasses these safety checks.
4.explain_fr: L'App Store d'Apple vérifie chaque application avant de la répertorier. Télécharger des applications d'autres sources contourne ces vérifications de sécurité.

4.q: Before installing a new app, you should check:
opts: The app's colour scheme
Reviews, the developer's name, and what permissions it requests
Whether it has a Canadian flag
How many photos it has
4.explain: Check the developer name, star rating, number of reviews, and permission requests. A legitimate app from a known company will request only the permissions it truly needs.
4.explain_fr: Vérifiez le nom du développeur, la note en étoiles, le nombre d'avis et les demandes d'autorisation. Une application légitime ne demandera que les autorisations dont elle a vraiment besoin.

4.q: An app asks for permission to access your contacts and location. You should:
opts: Always allow everything
Think about whether the app actually needs this — deny what it does not need
Delete the app immediately
Allow location but never contacts
4.explain: Always question permissions. A flashlight app has no reason to need your location. A contacts app does not need your camera. Deny permissions that do not make sense.
4.explain_fr: Remettez toujours en question les autorisations. Une application de lampe de poche n'a aucune raison d'avoir besoin de votre emplacement. Refusez les autorisations qui n'ont pas de sens.

4.q: Why is it important to keep your apps updated?
opts: Updates add more ads
Updates fix security problems and bugs
Updates delete your photos
Updates make the app smaller
4.explain: App updates often contain security patches that fix vulnerabilities discovered after the app was released. Keeping apps updated is one of the easiest ways to stay protected.
4.explain_fr: Les mises à jour d'applications contiennent souvent des correctifs de sécurité. Garder les applications à jour est l'un des moyens les plus simples de rester protégé.

4.q: A pop-up says you must install an app NOW or your phone will be damaged. You should:
opts: Install it immediately
Close the pop-up — this is a scam
Call your phone provider
Turn off Wi-Fi first, then install it
4.explain: Urgency is always a red flag. Real system alerts do not come from websites. Close the pop-up using your Home button and ignore the message entirely.
4.explain_fr: L'urgence est toujours un signal d'alarme. Les vraies alertes système ne viennent pas de sites Web. Fermez la fenêtre contextuelle et ignorez le message.

opts: A type of canned meat
Unwanted email, usually trying to sell something or scam you
Email from the government
A subscription newsletter
5.explain: Spam is any unwanted email sent in bulk. It ranges from annoying marketing to dangerous phishing attempts. Most email apps filter it automatically into a Spam folder.
5.explain_fr: Le spam est tout courriel non désiré envoyé en masse. Il va du marketing ennuyeux aux tentatives d'hameçonnage dangereuses.

5.q: You receive an email asking you to click a link to "verify your account." The safest response is:
opts: Click the link — it probably is your bank
Do not click — log in directly to your account through the official website or app
Reply to ask if it is real
Forward it to a friend
5.explain: Always go directly to your bank's official app or website — never through a link in an email. Scammers create convincing fake login pages at fake web addresses.
5.explain_fr: Allez toujours directement à l'application ou au site Web officiel de votre banque — jamais via un lien dans un courriel. Les escrocs créent de fausses pages de connexion convaincantes.

5.q: What does BCC mean in an email?
opts: Big Carbon Copy
Blind Carbon Copy — sends to someone without other recipients seeing
Back-up Copy Check
British Columbia Communication
5.explain: BCC (Blind Carbon Copy) lets you include someone on an email without other recipients knowing. It protects privacy when emailing groups.
5.explain_fr: CCI (Copie Carbone Invisible) vous permet d'inclure quelqu'un dans un courriel sans que les autres destinataires le sachent. Cela protège la vie privée lors d'envois groupés.

5.q: If you receive a text message from an unknown number with a link, you should:
opts: Tap the link to find out what it is
Delete the message — do not tap any links from unknown senders
Reply to ask who sent it
Forward it to 911
5.explain: Never tap links from unknown senders. Smishing (SMS phishing) is increasingly common. Legitimate organisations do not send unsolicited texts with links.
5.explain_fr: Ne cliquez jamais sur des liens provenant d'expéditeurs inconnus. Le smishing (hameçonnage par SMS) est de plus en plus courant.

5.q: Which is the most important thing to do when you have finished using your email on a shared computer?
opts: Clear the browser cache
Sign out / log out of your account
Delete all your messages
Change your password every time
5.explain: Signing out closes your session. Without this, the next person to use the computer could access your email by pressing Back in the browser.
5.explain_fr: Se déconnecter ferme votre session. Sans cela, la prochaine personne à utiliser l'ordinateur pourrait accéder à votre courriel en appuyant sur Retour dans le navigateur.

opts: A way to pay for goods at a store with cash
A way to send money to another person using email or a phone number
A type of credit card
A Canadian government benefit payment
6.explain: Interac e-Transfer is a Canadian service that lets you send money between bank accounts using only an email address or phone number. It is widely used and safe.
6.explain_fr: Le virement Interac est un service canadien qui vous permet d'envoyer de l'argent entre comptes bancaires en utilisant uniquement une adresse courriel ou un numéro de téléphone.

6.q: Which of these is a sign that an online shopping site may not be safe?
opts: It has https:// at the start of the address
The price is extremely low and there are no reviews
It asks you to create an account
It is listed on Google
6.explain: Unrealistically low prices and no reviews are major warning signs. Scam shopping sites often disappear after collecting payments, never shipping the goods.
6.explain_fr: Des prix irréalistes et l'absence d'avis sont de grands signaux d'alarme. Les faux sites de shopping disparaissent souvent après avoir collecté les paiements.

6.q: You notice an unfamiliar transaction on your bank statement. What should you do first?
opts: Wait to see if it fixes itself
Contact your bank immediately to report it
Post about it on Facebook
Move all your money to a different account
6.explain: Contact your bank immediately. Most banks have 24/7 fraud lines. Acting quickly can stop further transactions and often leads to a refund.
6.explain_fr: Contactez votre banque immédiatement. La plupart des banques ont des lignes de fraude 24h/24. Agir rapidement peut arrêter d'autres transactions.

6.q: What is the purpose of a credit score?
opts: It is your social media rating
It shows lenders how reliably you pay back borrowed money
It measures how much money you have saved
It is a government ID number
6.explain: A credit score is a number (typically 300–900 in Canada) that reflects your borrowing and repayment history. Lenders use it to decide whether to offer loans.
6.explain_fr: Un pointage de crédit est un chiffre (généralement 300 à 900 au Canada) qui reflète votre historique d'emprunts et de remboursements.

6.q: To pay safely online, the website address should start with:
opts: http://
www://
https://
ftp://
6.explain: The 's' in https:// stands for 'secure'. It means the connection between your browser and the website is encrypted, protecting your payment information.
6.explain_fr: Le 's' dans https:// signifie 'sécurisé'. Cela signifie que la connexion entre votre navigateur et le site Web est chiffrée, protégeant vos informations de paiement.

7.q: Where are photos stored when you take a picture on your iPhone?
opts: Only in your email
In the Photos app on your device
Automatically on Facebook
In your text messages
7.explain: Every photo you take goes into the Photos app automatically. If iCloud is enabled, they also back up to iCloud.
7.explain_fr: Chaque photo que vous prenez va automatiquement dans l'application Photos. Si iCloud est activé, elles sont également sauvegardées sur iCloud.

7.q: What does "iCloud Backup" do for your photos?
opts: Deletes your oldest photos automatically
Saves a copy of your photos to Apple's servers so they are safe if your phone is lost
Shares your photos with Apple employees
Compresses your photos to save space
7.explain: iCloud Backup creates a safe copy of your photos on Apple's servers. If your phone is lost, stolen, or broken, your photos are still accessible on any Apple device.
7.explain_fr: La sauvegarde iCloud crée une copie sécurisée de vos photos sur les serveurs d'Apple. Si votre téléphone est perdu ou cassé, vos photos restent accessibles.

7.q: How do you share a photo with a family member using an iPhone?
opts: Print it out and mail it
Open the photo, tap the Share button, and choose Messages, Email, or AirDrop
Take a photo of your screen
Ask Apple customer service to send it
7.explain: The Share button (a box with an arrow pointing up) appears when viewing any photo. It lets you send the photo via Messages, Email, AirDrop, or many other ways.
7.explain_fr: Le bouton Partager (une boîte avec une flèche vers le haut) apparaît lorsque vous regardez une photo. Il vous permet d'envoyer la photo par Messages, Courriel, AirDrop et plus.

7.q: If you accidentally delete a photo, where can you find it (within 30 days)?
opts: It is gone forever
In the "Recently Deleted" folder in the Photos app
In your email
In the App Store
7.explain: Deleted photos go to the Recently Deleted album for 30 days before being permanently removed. Open Photos → Albums → Recently Deleted to recover them.
7.explain_fr: Les photos supprimées vont dans l'album Supprimés récemment pendant 30 jours avant d'être définitivement effacées. Ouvrez Photos → Albums → Supprimés récemment.

7.q: What is a "shared album" in the Photos app?
opts: An album that anyone in the world can see
A private album you can share with specific family or friends
An album that automatically shares to social media
A paid feature only for iPhone Pro users
7.explain: A Shared Album lets you invite specific people (by email or phone number) to view and add photos. It is private — only your invitees can see it.
7.explain_fr: Un album partagé vous permet d'inviter des personnes spécifiques à voir et ajouter des photos. Il est privé — seules vos personnes invitées peuvent le voir.

8.q: FaceTime is a video calling app available on:
opts: All Android phones
Only Apple devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac)
Any smartphone if you pay a subscription
Windows computers only
8.explain: FaceTime works only between Apple devices. It is free and uses your internet connection. You can also use WhatsApp or Zoom to call non-Apple users.
8.explain_fr: FaceTime fonctionne uniquement entre appareils Apple. Il est gratuit et utilise votre connexion internet. Vous pouvez aussi utiliser WhatsApp ou Zoom pour appeler les non-utilisateurs Apple.

8.q: WhatsApp allows you to call and message people:
opts: Only in Canada
Anywhere in the world, for free, using your internet connection
Only to other WhatsApp users in your city
Only if they have an iPhone
8.explain: WhatsApp works worldwide, on any type of smartphone, completely free. It uses Wi-Fi or mobile data instead of your phone plan's minutes.
8.explain_fr: WhatsApp fonctionne partout dans le monde, sur tout type de téléphone intelligent, totalement gratuitement. Il utilise le Wi-Fi ou les données mobiles.

8.q: Before a video call with family, what is a good habit?
opts: Update all your apps
Make sure your device is charged, your camera is clean, and you are in a well-lit spot
Turn off notifications on all apps
Change your Wi-Fi password
8.explain: A charged battery, clean camera lens, and good lighting make a big difference to video call quality. Sit facing a window or lamp for the best picture.
8.explain_fr: Une batterie chargée, un objectif propre et un bon éclairage font une grande différence pour la qualité de l'appel vidéo. Asseyez-vous face à une fenêtre ou une lampe.

8.q: How do you mute yourself during a Zoom call?
opts: Put your finger over the microphone
Click or tap the microphone icon at the bottom of the screen
Unplug your headphones
Close the Zoom app
8.explain: The microphone icon appears at the bottom-left of the Zoom screen. Tap it once to mute (red slash appears), tap again to unmute.
8.explain_fr: L'icône du microphone apparaît en bas à gauche de l'écran Zoom. Appuyez une fois pour couper le son (une barre rouge apparaît), appuyez à nouveau pour rétablir le son.

8.q: Someone you met online says they love you and asks you to send them money. This is most likely:
opts: A genuine romance developing online
A romance scam — a common fraud targeting older adults
Normal online behaviour
A government assistance programme
8.explain: Romance scams are one of the most financially damaging crimes targeting older adults. Anyone who quickly professes love online and asks for money is almost certainly a scammer.
8.explain_fr: Les arnaques sentimentales sont l'un des crimes les plus dommageables ciblant les personnes âgées. Quelqu'un qui déclare rapidement son amour en ligne et demande de l'argent est presque certainement un escroc.

opts: A type of robot that can clean your house
Computer systems that can perform tasks that normally require human thinking, like answering questions
A new type of operating system replacing Windows
A social media platform
9.explain: AI refers to computer systems that can learn, reason, and make decisions — tasks that previously required human intelligence. Siri, ChatGPT, and Google Search all use AI.
9.explain_fr: L'IA désigne des systèmes informatiques capables d'apprendre, de raisonner et de prendre des décisions. Siri, ChatGPT et la recherche Google utilisent tous l'IA.

opts: A security camera system
A voice-activated AI assistant built into Apple devices
A paid subscription service
A Canadian government app
9.explain: Siri is Apple's built-in voice assistant. It is free, private (your voice stays on your device by default), and can set reminders, make calls, answer questions, and more.
9.explain_fr: Siri est l'assistant vocal intégré d'Apple. Il est gratuit, privé et peut définir des rappels, passer des appels, répondre à des questions et plus encore.

9.q: If an AI gives you health advice, you should:
opts: Follow it immediately — AI is always accurate
Use it as a starting point, but always confirm with a real doctor or pharmacist
Ignore it completely — AI is never right
Share it on Facebook for others to use
9.explain: AI can provide helpful general information about health topics, but it does not know your full medical history. Always confirm important health decisions with your doctor.
9.explain_fr: L'IA peut fournir des informations générales utiles sur les sujets de santé, mais elle ne connaît pas votre historique médical complet. Confirmez toujours les décisions de santé importantes avec votre médecin.

opts: A video filmed underwater
A video that uses AI to make someone appear to say or do something they never did
A type of news broadcast
A training video for divers
9.explain: Deepfakes use AI to swap faces or generate realistic fake videos. They are used in scams (fake CEO calls) and misinformation. If a video seems impossible, verify it.
9.explain_fr: Les hypertrucages utilisent l'IA pour échanger des visages ou générer de fausses vidéos réalistes. Utilisés dans les arnaques et la désinformation. Si une vidéo semble impossible, vérifiez-la.

9.q: What is the main privacy concern with AI voice assistants like Siri?
opts: They drain your battery too quickly
They may be listening for their "wake word" and could accidentally record conversations
They cost too much money per month
They replace your mobile data
9.explain: Devices with voice assistants listen for their wake word ("Hey Siri"). Occasionally they activate by accident. You can review and delete voice recordings in your privacy settings.
9.explain_fr: Les appareils avec assistants vocaux écoutent leur mot d'activation. Parfois ils s'activent par accident. Vous pouvez consulter et supprimer les enregistrements vocaux dans les paramètres de confidentialité.

10.q: What does "click and collect" mean when ordering groceries online?
opts: You click on an ad and they deliver for free
You order online and pick up your groceries at the store at a chosen time
A loyalty points programme
A feature that auto-reorders your groceries
10.explain: Click and Collect lets you shop online from home and choose a pickup time at your local store. You drive in, they load your car — no wandering the aisles.
10.explain_fr: Cliquer et collecter vous permet de faire vos courses en ligne depuis chez vous et de choisir une heure de collecte au magasin local. Vous conduisez, ils chargent votre voiture.

10.q: When ordering food delivery online, which is the safest payment method?
opts: Giving your credit card number over the phone to the driver
Paying through the secure app or website checkout
Sending an Interac e-Transfer to the restaurant directly
Paying cash to any person who arrives
10.explain: Always pay through the official app or website checkout. It encrypts your payment information. Never give card numbers verbally to drivers.
10.explain_fr: Payez toujours via la caisse officielle de l'application ou du site Web. Cela chiffre vos informations de paiement. Ne donnez jamais les numéros de carte verbalement aux livreurs.

10.q: You receive a delivery notification asking you to pay a customs fee to release your parcel. This is likely:
opts: A legitimate fee — pay it immediately
A common courier scam — do not pay without verifying with the real delivery company
A government levy you must pay by law
An error from Canada Post that can be disputed
10.explain: Package delivery scams are very common. Verify any fee by going directly to Canada Post or the courier's official website and entering your real tracking number.
10.explain_fr: Les arnaques de livraison de colis sont très courantes. Vérifiez tout frais en allant directement sur le site officiel de Postes Canada ou du transporteur et en entrant votre vrai numéro de suivi.

10.q: What should you do if a food delivery driver's name does not match the one shown in the app?
opts: Let them in — probably a substitute
Do not accept the delivery and report it through the app
Ask them for their employee ID
Rate them one star
10.explain: Always verify the driver's name and photo in the app before accepting. Mismatches are a safety concern — report it and request a redelivery.
10.explain_fr: Vérifiez toujours le nom et la photo du livreur dans l'application avant d'accepter. Les discordances sont une préoccupation de sécurité — signalez-le et demandez une nouvelle livraison.

10.q: PC Optimum, Air Miles, and Scene+ are examples of:
opts: Banking apps
Canadian grocery and retail loyalty rewards programmes
Government assistance programmes
Insurance products
10.explain: These are popular Canadian loyalty programmes. They reward purchases with points redeemable for discounts, free products, or travel. Free to join — no obligation to use.
10.explain_fr: Ce sont des programmes de fidélisation canadiens populaires. Ils récompensent les achats avec des points échangeables contre des réductions, des produits gratuits ou des voyages.

11.q: Before getting in a rideshare car (Uber/Lyft), you should:
opts: Get in quickly to save time
Check the licence plate, driver's name, and photo in the app match the car and driver
Share your trip details on social media
Pay in cash rather than the app
11.explain: Always verify: licence plate, driver's name, and driver's photo. Say "What's my name?" — the driver should know your name from the app, not the other way around.
11.explain_fr: Vérifiez toujours : la plaque d'immatriculation, le nom du conducteur et sa photo. Dites 'Quel est mon nom ?' — le conducteur doit connaître votre nom depuis l'application.

opts: The driver is speeding
Fares are temporarily higher due to high demand
Your account has been charged incorrectly
A discount is available
11.explain: Surge pricing happens when many people need rides at the same time (events, bad weather, late night). The app warns you and shows the multiplier. You can wait for it to drop.
11.explain_fr: La tarification dynamique se produit quand beaucoup de personnes ont besoin de courses en même temps. L'application vous avertit et affiche le multiplicateur. Vous pouvez attendre qu'il baisse.

11.q: If you leave something in an Uber, how do you recover it?
opts: Call 911
Use the "Find lost item" feature in the Uber app to contact the driver
Post in a Facebook group
Go back to where the trip started
11.explain: Open Uber → trip history → your recent trip → find lost item. The app connects you with the driver. There is usually a $20 return fee.
11.explain_fr: Ouvrez Uber → historique des courses → votre course récente → article perdu. L'application vous connecte avec le conducteur. Il y a généralement des frais de retour de 20 $.

11.q: The safest way to book an accessible ride with a mobility aid is:
opts: Wave from the street
Specify your accessibility need when booking in the app or call a mobility-specific service
Book a regular ride and hope the driver helps
Order two rides at once
11.explain: Uber WAV (Wheelchair Accessible Vehicle) and similar features let you book the right vehicle in advance. Local services like Handi-Van also serve mobility needs.
11.explain_fr: Uber WAV et des fonctionnalités similaires vous permettent de réserver le bon véhicule à l'avance. Les services locaux comme Handi-Van répondent également aux besoins de mobilité.

11.q: Why should you share your trip details with a family member before a rideshare?
opts: So they can pay your fare
As a safety measure so someone knows your route and expected arrival time
The app requires a second contact
To get a discount code
11.explain: The Uber and Lyft apps have a Share Trip button that sends real-time tracking to a contact. This is a simple safety habit for any journey.
11.explain_fr: Les applications Uber et Lyft ont un bouton Partager le trajet qui envoie un suivi en temps réel à un contact. C'est une habitude de sécurité simple pour tout voyage.

12.q: When waiting on hold with a customer service line, what is a useful strategy?
opts: Hang up and try a different company
Press 0 or say "representative" to reach a person faster, or use a callback option
Call 911 for help
Write an angry letter instead
12.explain: Many phone systems respond to '0' or 'representative' as a shortcut to a live agent. Callback options mean you do not lose your place in the queue.
12.explain_fr: De nombreux systèmes téléphoniques répondent à '0' ou 'représentant' comme raccourci vers un agent en direct. Les options de rappel signifient que vous ne perdez pas votre place dans la file d'attente.

12.q: Under Canadian consumer protection law, you generally have the right to:
opts: Return any product for any reason forever
A refund or exchange if a product is defective or not as described
Sue any company in the USA
A free replacement after 5 years
12.explain: Consumer protection laws in Ontario and across Canada give you the right to a refund or exchange when a product is defective, misrepresented, or not delivered as promised.
12.explain_fr: Les lois de protection des consommateurs en Ontario et au Canada vous donnent le droit à un remboursement ou un échange lorsqu'un produit est défectueux, mal représenté ou non livré comme promis.

12.q: A technician says they need "remote access" to your device to fix a problem you did not ask about. You should:
opts: Allow it — they are probably from Apple
Refuse. Never allow remote access from someone who contacted you unsolicited.
Give access but watch what they do
Ask them to call back tomorrow
12.explain: Remote access scams are common. Scammers pretending to be from Microsoft, Apple, or your bank ask for remote access, then steal files and install malware. Always refuse.
12.explain_fr: Les arnaques d'accès à distance sont courantes. Les escrocs se faisant passer pour Microsoft, Apple ou votre banque demandent un accès à distance, puis volent des fichiers. Refusez toujours.

12.q: If a family helper is managing your devices, it is good practice to:
opts: Give them your banking password too
Set clear boundaries about what they can access, and review your accounts regularly
Let them change all your passwords
Delete your accounts when they leave
12.explain: Helpers should only have access to what they need. Review your accounts periodically to ensure nothing unexpected has occurred. You keep control of banking passwords.
12.explain_fr: Les assistants ne devraient avoir accès qu'à ce dont ils ont besoin. Passez régulièrement en revue vos comptes pour vous assurer que rien d'inattendu ne s'est produit.

12.q: The best way to document a dispute with a company is to:
opts: Tell your friends
Keep written records of all calls, emails, and receipts with dates and names
Call the company every day
Post a negative review immediately
12.explain: Document everything: dates, times, names of representatives, what was said, and any reference numbers. This paper trail is essential if you escalate to consumer protection agencies.
12.explain_fr: Documentez tout : dates, heures, noms des représentants, ce qui a été dit et tout numéro de référence. Ce dossier est essentiel si vous faites appel aux agences de protection des consommateurs.

opts: Anyone on the internet can see your posts
Only people you have accepted as Facebook friends can see your posts
Only your family can see your posts
Facebook employees can see your posts
13.explain: Friends Only limits your posts to your accepted friend list. Check this setting regularly — Facebook sometimes changes defaults when it updates.
13.explain_fr: Amis seulement limite vos publications à votre liste d'amis acceptés. Vérifiez ce paramètre régulièrement — Facebook change parfois les valeurs par défaut lors de ses mises à jour.

13.q: You receive a Facebook friend request from someone claiming to be a person you already know. The safest response is:
opts: Accept immediately — they must be genuine
Check with the real person another way (phone call) before accepting
Ignore it forever
Report the request to the police
13.explain: Account cloning is common — scammers copy a real person's profile to send you a new request. Call your friend directly to verify before accepting.
13.explain_fr: Le clonage de compte est courant — les escrocs copient le profil d'une vraie personne pour vous envoyer une nouvelle demande. Appelez directement votre ami pour vérifier avant d'accepter.

13.q: On Facebook Marketplace, a buyer offers to pay more than your asking price by cheque. This is:
opts: Great luck — accept immediately
A common overpayment scam — do not accept
A special buyer protection programme
Normal marketplace behaviour
13.explain: The overpayment scam: scammer sends a cheque for more than the price, asks you to deposit it and return the difference. The cheque bounces days later — you lose both the item and the money.
13.explain_fr: L'arnaque du surpaiement : l'escroc envoie un chèque pour plus que le prix, vous demande de le déposer et de rembourser la différence. Le chèque rebondit quelques jours plus tard.

opts: Sharing long text articles
Sharing photos and short videos
Online banking
Video calls only
13.explain: Instagram is a photo and video sharing platform. You can post photos, short Reels videos, and Stories. It is owned by Meta (the same company as Facebook).
13.explain_fr: Instagram est une plateforme de partage de photos et de vidéos. Vous pouvez publier des photos, de courtes vidéos Reels et des Stories. Il appartient à Meta (la même société que Facebook).

opts: Fishing for catfish in a lake
Creating a fake online identity to deceive someone into a relationship
A type of social media filter
A privacy setting on Instagram
13.explain: Catfishing involves creating a fake persona online to form a deceptive relationship. It is common in romance scams and can cause significant emotional and financial harm.
13.explain_fr: Le catfishing consiste à créer une fausse personnalité en ligne pour former une relation trompeuse. Il est courant dans les arnaques sentimentales et peut causer des dommages importants.

14.q: A smart thermostat like a Nest or ecobee allows you to:
opts: Only control heating from home
Control your home's temperature remotely from your phone
Replace your furnace entirely
Use less electricity by turning off appliances
14.explain: Smart thermostats connect to your Wi-Fi. You control them from anywhere via a phone app. They can also learn your schedule and adjust automatically, saving energy.
14.explain_fr: Les thermostats intelligents se connectent à votre Wi-Fi. Vous les contrôlez de n'importe où via une application téléphonique. Ils peuvent également apprendre votre horaire et s'ajuster automatiquement.

14.q: Why is it important to change the default password on a new smart home device?
opts: Default passwords are hard to remember
Default passwords are publicly known and easy for hackers to exploit
It improves the device's speed
The manufacturer requires it for warranty
14.explain: Default passwords like 'admin' or '1234' are published in device manuals that anyone can find online. Hackers use them to access cameras and other smart devices.
14.explain_fr: Les mots de passe par défaut comme 'admin' ou '1234' sont publiés dans des manuels que n'importe qui peut trouver en ligne. Les pirates les utilisent pour accéder aux caméras et autres appareils intelligents.

14.q: The Ontario Enbridge Home Efficiency Rebate programme offers:
opts: Free smart devices to all seniors
Rebates of up to $5,000 on home energy improvements
Free furnace installation for all homeowners
A grant for solar panels
14.explain: The Enbridge Home Efficiency Rebate (HER+) offers rebates of up to $5,000 for eligible home upgrades like insulation, furnaces, and heat pumps. Apply through Enbridge's official website.
14.explain_fr: Le programme de remise pour l'efficacité énergétique résidentielle d'Enbridge offre des remises allant jusqu'à 5 000 $ pour des améliorations domiciliaires admissibles.

14.q: A video doorbell camera stores footage:
opts: Only on a TV inside your home
In the cloud (internet) and/or a local storage device, depending on the brand
At the police station automatically
Nowhere — it is only for live viewing
14.explain: Most video doorbells store recordings in the cloud (often with a monthly subscription) and/or a local storage card. Check the privacy policy for how long footage is kept.
14.explain_fr: La plupart des sonnettes vidéo stockent les enregistrements dans le cloud (souvent avec un abonnement mensuel) et/ou une carte de stockage locale.

14.q: Before buying a smart home device, you should check:
opts: That it matches your furniture colour
Whether it is compatible with your existing devices and what data it collects
That it has a Canadian flag on the box
Whether it was featured on TV
14.explain: Check compatibility (does it work with Apple Home, Google Home, or Amazon Alexa?) and the privacy policy (what data does it collect, who can access it?).
14.explain_fr: Vérifiez la compatibilité (fonctionne-t-il avec Apple Home, Google Home ou Amazon Alexa ?) et la politique de confidentialité (quelles données collecte-t-il, qui peut y accéder ?).

15.q: In Ontario, you can book a telehealth appointment through:
opts: Only by going to the hospital in person first
Through your family doctor's patient portal, or services like Maple or Teladoc
Only through a private paid service
The Ontario government automatically sets them up
15.explain: Many Ontario family doctors offer video appointments through portals like MyChart or Ocean. You can also use Maple for same-day virtual appointments (fees may apply).
15.explain_fr: De nombreux médecins de famille en Ontario proposent des consultations vidéo via des portails comme MyChart ou Ocean. Vous pouvez également utiliser Maple pour des consultations virtuelles le jour même.

opts: Emergency ambulance dispatch
Free, 24/7 telephone health advice from a registered nurse
Prescription delivery service
Hospital bed booking
15.explain: Dial 8-1-1 anytime for free health advice from a registered nurse. Available 24/7, 365 days a year. Translated services available.
15.explain_fr: Composez le 8-1-1 en tout temps pour des conseils de santé gratuits d'une infirmière autorisée. Disponible 24h/24, 365 jours par an. Services de traduction disponibles.

15.q: MyChart is an online portal that allows patients to:
opts: Order medications without a prescription
View their own medical records, test results, and appointment history
Chat with other patients
Access their OHIP billing history
15.explain: MyChart (used by many Ontario hospitals and clinics) lets you see your test results, appointment notes, and health summary. You need to ask your healthcare provider for an activation code.
15.explain_fr: MyChart (utilisé par de nombreux hôpitaux et cliniques en Ontario) vous permet de voir vos résultats de tests, notes de consultation et résumé de santé. Demandez à votre prestataire de soins un code d'activation.

15.q: When joining a video appointment with your doctor, what should you prepare in advance?
opts: Nothing — just wait for them to call
A list of your medications, current symptoms, and a quiet well-lit space
Your doctor's home address
A printed copy of your health card
15.explain: Before a telehealth appointment: write down your symptoms and questions, gather your medication list, charge your device, and find a quiet private space with good light.
15.explain_fr: Avant une consultation de télésanté : notez vos symptômes et questions, rassemblez votre liste de médicaments, chargez votre appareil et trouvez un espace tranquille et privé avec une bonne lumière.

opts: A debit card you pay with at the pharmacy
Your Ontario Health Insurance Plan card — shows you are covered for publicly funded health services
A credit card for medical expenses
A senior's transit pass
15.explain: Your green OHIP card proves you are entitled to publicly funded health care in Ontario. Carry it to all medical appointments. It is free and renewable from ServiceOntario.
15.explain_fr: Votre carte OHIP verte prouve que vous avez droit aux soins de santé financés par le secteur public en Ontario. Apportez-la à tous vos rendez-vous médicaux. Elle est gratuite et renouvelable auprès de ServiceOntario.

16.q: Before travelling internationally, you should back up your devices because:
opts: Customs may delete your photos
Devices can be lost, stolen, or damaged while travelling
Airlines require it before boarding
It speeds up your phone during the flight
16.explain: Travel increases the risk of device loss or damage. A recent backup (to iCloud or a computer) means your photos and data are safe even if your phone is gone.
16.explain_fr: Le voyage augmente le risque de perte ou de dommage des appareils. Une sauvegarde récente (sur iCloud ou un ordinateur) signifie que vos photos et données sont en sécurité même si votre téléphone disparaît.

16.q: Using public Wi-Fi in a hotel or airport is:
opts: Always completely safe
Risky for banking or sharing personal information — use a VPN or your phone's cellular data instead
Required by law in Ontario
Only unsafe in the USA
16.explain: Public Wi-Fi networks can be monitored by others. For banking or anything sensitive, use your phone's mobile data connection instead — it is encrypted.
16.explain_fr: Les réseaux Wi-Fi publics peuvent être surveillés par d'autres. Pour les opérations bancaires ou tout ce qui est sensible, utilisez plutôt la connexion de données mobiles de votre téléphone — elle est chiffrée.

opts: Your hotel room key not working
Fake booking websites that take your money without providing accommodation
A long queue at the airport
Weather delays on your flight
16.explain: Fake travel websites look professional but take your payment and provide no booking. Always verify: book directly through the hotel's official site or a known service like Booking.com.
16.explain_fr: Les faux sites de voyage ont l'air professionnels mais prennent votre paiement sans fournir de réservation. Vérifiez toujours : réservez directement via le site officiel de l'hôtel ou un service connu.

16.q: To avoid international roaming charges on your phone, you can:
opts: Turn off your phone for the entire trip
Buy a local SIM card, use a travel data plan from your carrier, or turn off data roaming
Only use the phone in your hotel room
Call your carrier from abroad — it is free
16.explain: Contact your carrier before you leave to discuss travel plans. Options include day passes, international plans, or buying a local SIM card at your destination.
16.explain_fr: Contactez votre opérateur avant de partir pour discuter des forfaits voyage. Les options incluent les passes journalières, les forfaits internationaux ou l'achat d'une carte SIM locale à destination.

16.q: The most important document to have a digital and printed copy of while travelling is:
opts: Your library card
Your passport (photo page), travel insurance details, and emergency contacts
Your bank statement
Your home address
16.explain: Photograph your passport photo page, travel insurance card, and emergency contacts. Store copies in email or iCloud. If your passport is lost, these copies speed up replacement.
16.explain_fr: Photographiez la page photo de votre passeport, votre carte d'assurance voyage et vos contacts d'urgence. Conservez des copies dans votre courriel ou iCloud. En cas de perte du passeport, ces copies accélèrent le remplacement.

17.q: ChatGPT, Claude, and Google Gemini are examples of:
opts: Social media platforms
AI language models that can answer questions and help with writing
Antivirus software
Operating systems
17.explain: These are large language models (LLMs) — AI systems trained on vast amounts of text that can answer questions, summarise information, and help with writing in a conversational way.
17.explain_fr: Ce sont des grands modèles de langage (LLM) — des systèmes d'IA entraînés sur de vastes quantités de texte pouvant répondre à des questions et aider à la rédaction.

17.q: When an AI gives you a medical, legal, or financial answer, you should:
opts: Trust it completely — AI has access to all current information
Use it as a starting point but verify with a qualified professional
Never ask AI about these topics
Print the answer and bring it to your doctor
17.explain: AI can provide useful background information, but it can make mistakes and does not know your personal situation. Always verify important decisions with qualified professionals.
17.explain_fr: L'IA peut fournir des informations générales utiles, mais elle peut faire des erreurs et ne connaît pas votre situation personnelle. Vérifiez toujours les décisions importantes avec des professionnels qualifiés.

17.q: AI tools can "hallucinate," which means they sometimes:
opts: Create visual art
Generate confident-sounding but completely false information
Refuse to answer difficult questions
Require you to pay for accurate answers
17.explain: AI hallucinations happen when the system generates plausible-sounding but factually incorrect content. Always cross-check important facts from AI with a reliable source.
17.explain_fr: Les hallucinations de l'IA se produisent lorsque le système génère un contenu qui semble plausible mais factuellement incorrect. Vérifiez toujours les faits importants provenant de l'IA avec une source fiable.

17.q: To protect your privacy when using AI tools, you should:
opts: Use your full legal name and address so they can personalise answers
Avoid sharing personal details like your home address, SIN, or financial information
Always share your email address
Use the same account for everything
17.explain: Treat AI chatbots like a public bulletin board — do not share anything you would not want stored or potentially seen by others. SIN, banking details, and home address should never be shared.
17.explain_fr: Traitez les chatbots IA comme un tableau d'affichage public — ne partagez rien que vous ne voudriez pas stocker ou potentiellement vu par d'autres. NAS, coordonnées bancaires et adresse ne doivent jamais être partagés.

17.q: A good way to check whether an AI's answer is accurate is to:
opts: Ask the AI the same question three times
Cross-reference the answer with a trusted website or authoritative source
Ask a different AI the same question
Trust it if it sounds confident
17.explain: Verify important AI answers using trusted sources: Government of Canada websites, your bank's official site, or established health organisations. Confidence in tone is not a reliability indicator.
17.explain_fr: Vérifiez les réponses importantes de l'IA en utilisant des sources de confiance : sites Web du gouvernement du Canada, site officiel de votre banque ou organisations de santé établies.

18.q: Which of the following helps reduce loneliness for seniors who live alone?
opts: Avoiding technology as it is confusing
Using video calling apps like FaceTime or WhatsApp to see family and friends regularly
Only calling people on a landline phone
Waiting for people to visit in person
18.explain: Video calling allows you to see faces and expressions — not just hear voices. Regular video calls with family have been shown to significantly reduce feelings of isolation.
18.explain_fr: Les appels vidéo vous permettent de voir les visages et les expressions — pas seulement d'entendre les voix. Des appels vidéo réguliers avec la famille réduisent considérablement les sentiments d'isolement.

18.q: A good way to share many photos with multiple family members at once is:
opts: Print them and mail individual copies to everyone
Create a Shared Album in the Photos app and invite family members
Post them publicly on Facebook
Email them one by one to each person
18.explain: A Shared Album in Apple Photos lets you create a private gallery and invite specific family members by email. Everyone can view, comment, and add their own photos.
18.explain_fr: Un album partagé dans Photos Apple vous permet de créer une galerie privée et d'inviter des membres de la famille spécifiques par courriel. Tout le monde peut voir, commenter et ajouter ses propres photos.

opts: You must have a smartphone to receive texts
It allows a quick written message without needing the other person to be available to talk
It uses your home internet connection
It is more expensive than calling
18.explain: Text messages are asynchronous — the receiver can read and reply when it suits them. They are especially useful for sharing information quickly without a full phone call.
18.explain_fr: Les messages textes sont asynchrones — le destinataire peut lire et répondre quand cela lui convient. Ils sont particulièrement utiles pour partager rapidement des informations sans un appel téléphonique complet.

18.q: When using technology to help in difficult times (illness, grief), a helpful first step is:
opts: Buying the most expensive device available
Reaching out through a video call or message to let family know you need support
Posting your situation on social media
Calling 911 for emotional support
18.explain: Technology is a tool for connection. During difficult times, a simple video call or message to family or a trusted friend can make a significant difference to wellbeing.
18.explain_fr: La technologie est un outil de connexion. En période difficile, un simple appel vidéo ou message à la famille ou un ami de confiance peut faire une grande différence pour le bien-être.

18.q: Online communities and forums for seniors are useful because:
opts: They replace real-world friendships entirely
They connect you with people who share your interests or experiences, reducing isolation
They are only for people under 50
They require a monthly subscription fee
18.explain: Online communities (like Facebook groups for gardeners, crafters, or retirees) connect you with like-minded people worldwide. Many are free and accessible from your iPad.
18.explain_fr: Les communautés en ligne (comme les groupes Facebook pour les jardiniers, artisans ou retraités) vous connectent avec des personnes partageant vos intérêts dans le monde entier. Beaucoup sont gratuits.

opts: A computer virus shaped like a foot
The trail of data and accounts you leave behind through your online activity
Your typed signature on a document
A special printer for digital photos
19.explain: Your digital footprint includes all your online accounts, email addresses, social media profiles, and browsing history. Being aware of it helps you manage your privacy.
19.explain_fr: Votre empreinte numérique comprend tous vos comptes en ligne, adresses courriel, profils de médias sociaux et historique de navigation. En être conscient vous aide à gérer votre vie privée.

19.q: Why is it important to write down a list of your important online accounts?
opts: So that advertisers can target you better
So that a trusted person can help manage your accounts if you become unable to do so yourself
To share the list on social media
Banks require it by law
19.explain: A trusted account list (stored securely, not in plain view) ensures a family member or executor can access and close important accounts if needed. This is part of digital estate planning.
19.explain_fr: Une liste de comptes de confiance (stockée en sécurité) garantit qu'un membre de la famille ou un exécuteur peut accéder et fermer les comptes importants si nécessaire. C'est une partie de la planification successorale numérique.

19.q: The best place to store backup copies of your important digital photos is:
opts: Only on your phone
iCloud AND a second backup (external hard drive or USB stick) kept at a different location
On Facebook only
Printed copies only
19.explain: The 3-2-1 rule: 3 copies, 2 different formats, 1 offsite. iCloud is your first backup. An external hard drive kept at a family member's home is your insurance.
19.explain_fr: La règle 3-2-1 : 3 copies, 2 formats différents, 1 hors site. iCloud est votre première sauvegarde. Un disque dur externe conservé chez un membre de la famille est votre assurance.

opts: A friend to take over your account while you are on holiday
A trusted person you designate to manage your Facebook profile after you pass away
Automatic deletion of your account after 30 days
Two people to share one Facebook account
19.explain: Facebook Legacy Contact lets you designate someone to manage your account — updating your profile photo, pinning a tribute post — after you pass. Set it in Settings → Memorialisation Settings.
19.explain_fr: Le Contact héritier Facebook vous permet de désigner quelqu'un pour gérer votre compte après votre décès. Configurez-le dans Paramètres → Paramètres de commémoration.

19.q: "Cleaning up your digital life" before or during later life is valuable because:
opts: It makes your phone run faster
It reduces the administrative burden on family and ensures your wishes are known regarding your accounts and data
It is required by Canadian law
It improves your credit score
19.explain: Closing unused accounts, documenting important ones, and noting your wishes (delete vs. memorialise) reduces the work for loved ones and ensures your digital legacy reflects what you want.
19.explain_fr: Fermer les comptes inutilisés, documenter les importants et noter vos souhaits réduit le travail pour vos proches et garantit que votre héritage numérique reflète ce que vous souhaitez.
